subject: Post-discovery — schedule technical interop workshop & ops questions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lee Chang <lee@datahorizon.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery — schedule technical interop workshop & ops questions

Hi Lee / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can get a hands-on session booked with our ML / infra folks.

Recap (very short):
- Main objective: validate serving fit for Data Horizon’s recommender (latency SLO ~50ms P95, batch sizes up to 8).
- Environment: you mentioned GCP (us-west1), planning to use Vertex & occasional on-prem for sensitive models.
- Key blockers: verification of latency at scale, model size & kv-cache behavior, and data retention controls.

Proposal — technical interop workshop (60–90 min):
- Audience: your infra engineering + model owners, our runtime/ops + security engineer.
- Goals: walk through a short end-to-end serving demo, run a few perf checks on representative payloads, confirm rollout & fallback policies, and capture checklist for Dedicated/Private options.

Could you share 2–3 slots you have available in the next 10 business days (PDT preferred)? We typically run these between 60–90 minutes. Example slots that work for us:
- Tue 11 Aug, 09:30–11:00 PT
- Wed 12 Aug, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 13 Aug, 08:30–10:00 PT

Attached is a very short draft agenda and a runbook stub for Rafael to use as a checklist (attachment stubs below).

Prep asks if possible before the workshop:
1) A small sample payload (5–10 representative requests) and a note on typical token lengths.
2) Any firewall/egress rules we should know about for a brief connectivity test.
3) Confirm who will be the model owner and the infra lead from your side (names + emails).

If you prefer, we can also do a shorter 45-minute technical sync first, but we find 60–90 gives enough time to validate perf without follow-ups.

Thanks — I’ll hold those three slots tentative until you confirm. Rafael and Grace are copied to coordinate the ops and security pieces.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs:
- redwood-interop-agenda-v1.md (3-item agenda, timeboxed)
- rdw-runbook-stub.pdf (ops checklist)

We'd like to lock a slot. Availability from our side (PDT):

- Lee Chang (platform lead) — lee@datahorizon.com
- Priya Singh (ML lead) — priya.singh@datahorizon.com

We run most workloads on GCP us-west1 and do have an internal egress policy (will share the firewall snippet). We can also provide a small sample of representative payloads (Priya will send that after this thread).

One ask: do you have a short checklist for what telemetry we should capture during the session (e.g., latency buckets, payload size, tokens)? That will help Priya prep the datasets.

Look forward to it — please confirm final slot and attendee list.

Best,
Lee
